steps.title: Prepare cell suspensions
steps.instruction: Resuspend each sample (or sorted population) in 180 µL Cell Staining Buffer in a LoBind tube.

steps.title: Label cells with Sample Tags (optional)
steps.instruction: Perform sequential Sample Tag labeling for 20 000–1 000 000 cells per sample (up to 100 antibodies per reaction).

substeps.instruction: Prepare a spreadsheet assigning Sample Tag 1–12 to each sample.
Quick‑spin Sample Tag tubes, then add 180 µL cell suspension to the corresponding tube and pipette‑mix.
Incubate at room temperature (15 °C–25 °C) for 20 min.
Transfer to a 1.5 mL LoBind tube, add 1 mL cold Cell Staining Buffer, pipette‑mix, centrifuge 400 × g for 5 min, and carefully pipette off supernatant (repeat wash three times).
Resuspend the final pellet in 100 µL cold Cell Staining Buffer.

steps.title: Pool labeled samples (optional)
steps.instruction: Combine all Sample‑Tag‑labeled cell suspensions, adjust volume to 1.5 mL with Cell Staining Buffer, centrifuge, and resuspend in 100 µL cold staining buffer.

substeps.instruction: If cell concentrations are unknown, count cells with Trypan blue after the final wash to determine mixing ratios.
Centrifuge pooled tube at 400 × g for 5 min, remove supernatant, and resuspend pellet in 100 µL cold staining buffer.

steps.title: Fc‑block (myeloid/B cells)
steps.instruction: Block non‑specific Fc receptor binding before Ab‑Oligo staining.

substeps.instruction: Prepare Fc Block master mix on ice (Table 1): 90 µL Sample (cell suspension) + 10 µL Human Fc Block = 100 µL total.
Add 100 µL Fc Block master mix to the cells, incubate on ice 10 min.
Add 1 mL cold Cell Staining Buffer, centrifuge 400 × g for 5 min, remove supernatant, and resuspend in 100 µL cold staining buffer. (Washes 8e–h may be omitted for very low cell numbers.)

steps.title: Prepare 2× AbSeq master mix
steps.instruction: Make the 2× AbSeq antibody‑oligo labeling master mix on ice according to Table 2.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge BD AbSeq Ab‑Oligos at 400 × g for 30 s, keep on ice.
Pipette all reagents listed in Table 2 into a new 1.5 mL LoBind tube on ice, mix gently, and keep on ice.

steps.title: Label cells with AbSeq Ab‑Oligos
steps.instruction: Combine pooled cells (100 µL) with 100 µL 2× AbSeq labeling master mix, mix, and incubate on ice 30 min.

steps.title: Wash AbSeq‑labeled cells
steps.instruction: Perform three washes with cold Cell Staining Buffer, then resuspend in Sample Buffer for downstream steps.

substeps.instruction: Add 1 mL Cell Staining Buffer, pipette‑mix, centrifuge 400 × g for 5 min, remove supernatant (repeat three times).
Resuspend final pellet in 100 µL cold Sample Buffer.
Take 10 µL for Trypan blue viability; aim for >300 000 cells / mL and >90 % viability.

steps.title: Thaw PCR reagents
steps.instruction: Thaw on‑ice the following at room temperature (15 °C–25 °C): Nuclease‑Free water, Bead RT/PCR enhancer, Elution Buffer, Universal Oligo, Library Forward Primer, Library Reverse Primer 1–4, PCR1 Panel Supplement (optional), PCR2 Panel Supplement (optional), Bead Resuspension Buffer, Sample Tag PCR1 Primer, Sample Tag PCR2 Primer, BD AbSeq Primer.

steps.title: Set up PCR1 master mix
steps.instruction: Prepare the PCR1 reaction mix on ice in a 1.5 mL LoBind tube according to Table 6, vortex, briefly centrifuge, and keep on ice.

steps.title: Combine beads with PCR1 mix
steps.instruction: Resuspend Exonuclease I‑treated beads in Bead Resuspension Buffer on a magnet (<2 min), discard supernatant, add 200 µL PCR1 mix, mix, and aliquot 50 µL into each of four 0.2 mL PCR tubes.

steps.title: Run PCR1
steps.instruction: Place tubes in a pre‑heated thermal cycler (lid ≥95 °C) and run the program in Table 7 (Hot Start 95 °C 3 min; 10–15 cycles of 95 °C 30 s, 60 °C 3 min, 72 °C 1 min; final extension 72 °C 5 min; hold 14 °C).

substeps.instruction: Do not use fast‑cycling mode.
After cycling, briefly centrifuge tubes.

steps.title: Collect PCR1 supernatant
steps.instruction: Combine the four PCR1 reactions, place on magnet 2 min, and transfer the supernatant (PCR1 products) to a new LoBind tube without disturbing beads.

substeps.instruction: Optional: add 200 µL cold Bead Resuspension Buffer to beads, mix, and store beads at 2 °C–8 °C for possible re‑use.

steps.title: Double‑sided SPRISelect purification
steps.instruction: Separate short AbSeq/Sample Tag (~170 bp) from long mRNA (350–800 bp) PCR1 products using SPRISelect beads.

substeps.instruction: Prepare fresh 80 % ethanol (4 mL absolute ethanol + 1 mL nuclease‑free water).
Vortex SPRISelect reagent 1 min; add 140 µL beads to the 200 µL PCR1 product, mix 10×, incubate 5 min at RT.
Place on magnet 5 min; transfer 400 µL supernatant (contains AbSeq/Sample Tag) to a new tube.
Keep the supernatant at RT while purifying the bead‑bound mRNA fraction.

steps.title: Purify mRNA PCR1 products
steps.instruction: Perform two 80 % ethanol washes on the bead‑bound mRNA fraction and elute in Elution Buffer.

substeps.instruction: With beads on magnet, add 500 µL 80 % ethanol, incubate 30 s; repeat once.
Remove residual ethanol, air‑dry beads 5 min at RT.
Resuspend beads in 30 µL Elution Buffer, mix, incubate 2 min, brief spin, place on magnet until clear (≤30 s).
Transfer eluate (~30 µL) to a new LoBind tube; store at 2 °C–8 °C ≤24 h or –25 °C to –15 °C ≤6 months.

steps.title: Purify AbSeq/Sample Tag PCR1 products
steps.instruction: Bind the 400 µL supernatant to SPRISelect beads and elute.

substeps.instruction: Add 100 µL SPRISelect beads, mix 10×, incubate 5 min at RT.
Magnet 5 min, discard supernatant.
Two 80 % ethanol washes (500 µL each, 30 s each).
Air‑dry beads 5 min, elute in 30 µL Elution Buffer, incubate 2 min, brief spin, magnet until clear.
Transfer eluate (~30 µL) to a new LoBind tube; store as above.

steps.title: Quantify AbSeq/Sample Tag PCR1
steps.instruction: Dilute 2 µL of the purified product 1:1 with nuclease‑free water, run on Agilent TapeStation High Sensitivity D5000, and record the peak (~170 bp).

steps.title: Set up PCR2 master mixes
steps.instruction: Prepare PCR2 mixes for targeted mRNA (Table 9) and Sample Tag (Table 10) on ice in separate 1.5 mL LoBind tubes.

steps.title: Run PCR2 reactions
steps.instruction: Add 5 µL of each PCR1 product to 45 µL of the appropriate PCR2 mix, vortex, centrifuge, and run the program in Table 11 (Hot Start 95 °C 3 min; 6–8 cycles of 95 °C 30 s, 60 °C 3 min, 72 °C 1 min; final extension 72 °C 5 min; hold 14 °C).

substeps.instruction: Do not use fast‑cycling mode.
Pause point: PCR2 products can be stored at 2 °C–8 °C ≤24 h or –25 °C to –15 °C ≤6 months.

steps.title: Purify PCR2 products
steps.instruction: Perform SPRISelect bead purification separately for mRNA and Sample Tag PCR2 products.

substeps.instruction: For mRNA: add 40 µL beads to 50 µL product; for Sample Tag: add 60 µL beads to 50 µL product.
Mix 10×, incubate 5 min at RT, magnet 3 min, discard supernatant.
Two 80 % ethanol washes (200 µL each).
Air‑dry beads 3 min, elute in 30 µL Elution Buffer, incubate 2 min, brief spin, magnet until clear.
Transfer eluates to separate LoBind tubes (≈30 µL each) and store as above.

steps.title: Quantify PCR2 products
steps.instruction: Measure concentrations with Qubit dsDNA HS assay; dilute mRNA PCR2 to 0.2–2.7 ng/µL and Sample Tag PCR2 to 0.1–1.1 ng/µL.

steps.title: Prepare indexing PCR master mix
steps.instruction: Make the indexing PCR mix for the three libraries (mRNA, AbSeq, Sample Tag) on ice according to Table 12 (+10 % overage).

steps.title: Set up indexing PCR
steps.instruction: In separate 0.2 mL PCR tubes, combine 3 µL of each diluted library (mRNA, Sample Tag, and AbSeq PCR1 product) with 47 µL indexing mix.

substeps.instruction: Vortex gently and briefly centrifuge.

steps.title: Run indexing PCR
steps.instruction: Run the program in Table 13 (Hot Start 95 °C 5 min; 6–8 cycles of 95 °C 30 s, 60 °C 30 s, 72 °C 30 s; final extension 72 °C 1 min; hold 14 °C).

substeps.instruction: Do not use fast‑cycling mode.
Pause point: indexed libraries can be stored at 2 °C–8 °C ≤24 h or –25 °C to –15 °C ≤6 months.

steps.title: Purify indexed libraries
steps.instruction: Perform SPRISelect bead cleanup for each indexed library.

substeps.instruction: Add 35 µL beads to 50 µL mRNA library; add 40 µL beads to each 50 µL AbSeq and Sample Tag library.
Mix 10×, incubate 5 min at RT, magnet 3 min, discard supernatant.
Two 80 % ethanol washes (200 µL each).
Air‑dry beads 3 min, elute in 30 µL Elution Buffer, incubate 2 min, brief spin, magnet until clear.
Collect eluates (~30 µL) into separate LoBind tubes as the final sequencing libraries.

steps.title: Final library quality control
steps.instruction: Quantify 2 µL of each final library with Qubit dsDNA HS (expect >1.5 ng/µL) and assess fragment size on Agilent TapeStation (mRNA size distribution, Sample Tag ~290 bp, AbSeq ~270 bp).

steps.title: Calculate library concentrations (nM)
steps.instruction: Use C = X × 1×10⁶ ÷ (MW × S), where X = Qubit ng/µL, MW = 660 g/mol per bp, and S = average library size (bp) from TapeStation.

steps.title: Dilute and pool libraries
steps.instruction: Dilute each library to the recommended 1–4 nM (Illumina guide), then pool volumes according to desired read allocation per sample.

substeps.instruction: Determine reads per cell (e.g., 5 000 reads × 10 000 cells = 5 ×10⁶ reads).
Calculate each library’s fraction of total reads, multiply by total pool volume (e.g., 150 µL) to obtain volume per library.
If calculated volume is very low, make a larger pool and take an aliquot for sequencing.

steps.title: Sequence libraries
steps.instruction: Load the pooled libraries onto the appropriate Illumina flowcell (MiSeq, NextSeq, NovaSeq, etc.) at the recommended loading concentration (see Table 15) and include 10–20 % PhiX.

substeps.instruction: Target sequencing depths: mRNA 5 000–10 000 reads/cell, Sample Tag 600–1 000 reads/cell, AbSeq 400–1 000 reads/cell per antibody.

steps.title: Primary analysis pipeline
steps.instruction: Process sequencing data using the BD Rhapsody Targeted Analysis Pipeline on Seven Bridges.

substeps.instruction: Download FASTQ files from BaseSpace.
Create a Seven Bridges account (http://www.sevenbridges.com/bdgenomics/) and a new project.
Upload FASTQ files (R1 and R2) and reference FASTA files: generate AbSeq reference at http://abseq-ref-gen.genomics.bd.com/ and upload; add the appropriate mRNA panel FASTA from the Demo Project.
Add the app “BD Rhapsody™ Targeted Analysis Pipeline” and run it.
In App Settings, select “Single‑Cell Multiplexing Kit‑Human” under Multiplexing_Settings and annotate Sample Tags.
Run the pipeline; upon completion retrieve output files: RSEC_MolsPerCell.csv, DBEC_MolsPerCell.csv, Sample_Tag_Calls.csv, and per‑Sample‑Tag zip files.
